title: How a poster is assembled
subtitle: XYZ Layout Engine, exploded: the “Fuel Well. Live Well.” poster as three layers. Follow a coloured thread from data at the back to pixels at the front.
editWordsBody: Change the headline in `fixture.json` → `sections.header.headline`. The JSON is the only place the words live.
swapLeafBody: The artwork is chosen by ID: set `hero.illustrationId` from `"leaf_glow"` to another illustration in `nutrition/assets/web/`.
moveLeafBody: The recipe places the leaf with `left: 262, top: -34, width: 428, height: 640`. Raise left to 362 and the leaf slides 100 px right.
recipeStep1: **Render time:** the engine loads the recipe `nutrition.mjs` in **Node.js** and calls `buildScene(fixture)`. It reruns this to shrink type if text overflows, up to 10 tries.
recipeStep2: The result is a **scene tree**: plain JS objects, each with a `style`, e.g. the leaf’s `{ id: 'hero_img', style: { left: 262, top: -34 } }`.
recipeStep3: **CSS:** in the exported HTML each style object becomes inline CSS styling, e.g. `left:262px; top:-34px; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase`.
satoriCaption: Satori lays out the scene as SVG; resvg rasterizes that SVG to PNG.
playwrightCaption: Playwright drives headless Chromium: Chromium lays out the HTML + CSS, then captures a PNG screenshot.
eitherHtml: Either backend can also export the same offline HTML file (toDocument).
htmlCardBody: Real text: select, copy, search. Fonts and images are embedded, so the offline HTML opens with no server or network.
pngCardBody: A fixed grid of pixels. Looks the same everywhere, but the words can’t be selected or edited.
footer: Edit captions in output/src/content.json · rebuild with: node output/src/build.mjs
